line_items.reasoning: Full-year operational sales guidance was raised again by ~$900M to a midpoint of $92.9B (4.8% growth), well above the prior Q1 guidance midpoint of $92B (3.3%–4.3% range), driven by strong Innovative Medicine and MedTech outperformance in Q2.
Full-year adjusted EPS guidance was raised by $0.25 to a midpoint of $10.85, exceeding the prior Q1 guidance range of $10.50–$10.70, despite ongoing Intra-Cellular dilution and tariff headwinds.

Innovative Medicine margin fell from 44.6% to 42.7% and MedTech margin fell from 25.7% to 22.2% YoY in Q2, suggesting the 300 bps operating margin improvement target guided in Q1 is under pressure from STELARA gross profit erosion and acquisition-related costs.

Net interest expense came in above the guided $100M–$200M range, as the $32B net debt position from the $14.5B Intra-Cellular acquisition drove adjusted diluted EPS down 1.8% YoY to $2.77; additionally, the effective tax rate was guided higher to 17%–17.5%, adding further headwinds not anticipated in prior guidance.
